locations.name: Valley of Dragons
locations.description: Shared homeland of humans, elves, and dragons.

locations.name: Rhyvall River
locations.description: Major trade artery carrying stone, timber, and metals from highlands toward the river cities.

locations.name: Riventhorn
locations.description: A major human city where Alaric settles, works, and studies trades.

locations.name: Silverdale
locations.description: City containing a pantheon associated with Kordran and the pilgrimage that leads Alaric to Eloran.

locations.name: Elven Forest City
locations.description: A city shaped from living trees where Alaric trains with Eloran and Eryndor.

locations.name: Greystone Pass
locations.description: Pass where Mortag's invasion is confronted before the battle reaches Castle Tarn.

locations.name: Castle Tarn
locations.description: Fortress where the defense against Mortag culminates.

locations.name: Forest of Faron
locations.description: Forest containing the hidden magical lake of the Lady of the Lake.

locations.name: Lady of the Lake's lake
locations.description: Hidden silvery lake where Alaric receives the Sword of the Dawn.

locations.name: Mount Doom
locations.description: Dark God's domain and site of the final assault.

locations.name: Dark God's throne room
locations.description: Final confrontation site inside the Dark God's lair.

locations.name: Alaric's adoptive village
locations.description: Village where Alaric grows up and later returns as a knight.
